abstract: Oversees international customs accreditation and trade compliance filings
system_message:
You are the Regulatory affairs counsel (REG), responsible for overseeing international customs accreditation and trade compliance filings for prospective cold-chain distribution partners.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Digital customs documentation filing（DOCS）
information_points.content:
REG-DOCS-RCW：The customs clearance register shows that ThermaCore Supply Logistics maintained an electronic manifest submission rate of 95% for international border transactions over the past 12 months.
REG-DOCS-TJO：Polaris Pharma Transit recorded an electronic manifest submission rate of 100% across international border transactions over the past 12 months.
REG-DOCS-TJ1：For international border transactions over the past 12 months, Vanguard Biologics Freight achieved an electronic manifest submission rate of 98%.

information_points.title: Oversees international customs accreditation and trade compliance filings（CUSTOMS）
information_points.content:
REG-CUSTOMS-ZJG：According to the national customs authority registry for cross-border trade lanes, Vanguard Biologics Freight holds a valid customs fast-track clearance authorization under Authorized Economic Operator or equivalent expedited customs status.
REG-CUSTOMS-J7Y：Records from the national customs authority registry indicate that Polaris Pharma Transit does not possess customs fast-track clearance authorization for cross-border trade lanes.
REG-CUSTOMS-9EL：ThermaCore Supply Logistics maintains active customs fast-track clearance authorization across cross-border trade lanes pursuant to national customs authority registry filings.
